Ava: Morning — quick cutline check. What’s the status on cherry-picks for the analytics export fix? I have one more tiny PR queued but need a merge before noon.
Jin: Landed the big one last night, left one conflict on export-service. @Ravi can you handle the resolve? I pinged in your PR.
Ravi: I'm on it, resolving now. FYI I'm seeing a stale schema migration causing the conflict. Should be a quick rebase.
Nora: Canary looks green in eu-west. Small spike at 95th latency but still within SLO. :tada:
Marta: Heads up — CI flaky on integration-tests/export. If anyone's running local, use `ci/local-run --focus export` to repro faster.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy 2026-06-08T07:12:00Z -> us-west-2 succeeded (v2.3.7-canary).
Ava: @Ravi can you also cherry-pick abc123 into release-2.3 branch? command attached: ```git checkout release-2.3
git cherry-pick -x abc123
git push origin release-2.3```
Ravi: Done and pushed. PR #4893 created for the backport, just needs one approval.
Jin: Pinging @Marta for a quick CI re-run on PR #4893. If green, we can cut to train.
Marta: Kicked CI rerun. ETA ~6m.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline for PR #4893 started — jobs: build, unit, integ(export).
Marta: Integ failed on timeout, logs show export-db connection reset x2. Retrying with longer timeout.
Ravi: I can add a retry in the test harness, will open a tiny PR to bump timeout.
Ava: Blockers? Any manual steps before we cut to main release train? Need to schedule the post-cut smoke test.
Nora: I'll grab smoke test at 12:15 PST, can do quick sanity and dataset checks.
Jin: No other blockers from infra. If PR green, we target the 13:00 cut window.
Marta: CI green now on rerun. PR #4893 merged.
Ava: Awesome — thanks all. Rolling forward to cut. I'll post cut notice in #announcements and update the release board.
